predicates.pass_condition: CF023 uniquely links QX-38983-2025 to NON38983, MA RPS 1015-02, Deer Island Treatment Plant STG, and the relevant tender identity; its ordered events end in RELEASED at 11:36:20 EDT before noon. CEDGE014 and AEDGE052-AEDGE053 preserve the prior authority-and-tender join into GN012, while CEDGE015 and AEDGE054 alone carry the new release gate into GN005. RULE017 consumes preserved FACT001, FACT016, and FACT035 and derives new route target FACT043 as true from the exact final event before propagating the preserved 150-unit LOT-D contribution. Removing, delaying, or mismatching the release instead derives FACT043 as false and yields only the declared 800 seller, 200 deficiency, 160 residual, USD 14,220 net, and 800 seller-inventory counterfactual. CF023 contains no terminal result or private metadata.

route_context.business_goal: Close the seller's 2024 Class I delivery without paying for unusable certificates and preserve a supportable compliance inventory.
route_context.deliverable_class: Auditable certificate-delivery settlement workbook with embedded procurement and accounting decision summary
difficulty_sources: Temporal qualification and lifecycle precedence across different systems
Pixel-essential reversal and overlap evidence whose raw baselines and dimension-preserved annotations traverse two independently auditable PDF-to-DOCX chains
Visual trade-to-allocation-to-registry custody handoff that separates executed cover damages from buyer-held compliance inventory
As-of qualification-exception event precedence after exact unit authority matching and before downstream settlement propagation
route_context.natural_request_context: A settlement manager needs a single spreadsheet workpaper for the procurement director and controller after the final tender arrived on June 9.
route_context.terminal_decision: After admitting the reversal and overlap only from the two raw-plus-marked cross-document evidence pairs, approve USD 16,920 net payable; post 950 seller RECs and 40 cover RECs separately; dispute 50 seller RECs, record a 10-REC residual shortfall, send dispute by June 16, and preserve July 1 filing readiness.
route_context.unique_resolution: Exact source precedence, inclusive serial arithmetic, lifecycle event order, signed cure hierarchy, cover execution, paired raw/derived lineage admissibility, and conservation equations admit only the stated quantities, payable, and deadlines. The cover inventory component additionally requires an exact trade-to-allocation-to-final-registry-custody match by the cutoff; absent that final handoff, the cover posting is zero and the residual is fifty while the damage offset remains unchanged. The otherwise valid LOT-D unit must additionally have QX-38983-2025 in a final released state by noon; a pending, late, or mismatched release withholds its 150 certificates from the close and forces the stated downstream quantity, payable, inventory, and residual counterfactual.

rules.counterexample: Deriving clearance from the current qualified-unit workbook row or valid registry custody while QX-38983-2025 is still on hold bypasses the required CF023 event state and fails the old-to-new control dependency.
rules.resolution_order: Preserved trigger and valid-unit state; exact GIS and RPS identity; controlling DOER qualification; ordered CF023 exception-case events; derive FACT043 from the last event effective by noon; then quantity, payable, inventory, and residual propagation.
rules.statement: After exact DOER unit matching, generation-period testing, custody, and uniqueness establish an otherwise valid lot, derive its settlement clearance only when the exact qualification-exception case has a final RELEASED event effective by the evidence cutoff; that new clearance then gates downstream quantity, payable, inventory, and residual propagation, and cannot qualify a unit that fails controlling DOER rules.
truth_conditions: Preserved FACT016 establishes 150 valid, unique, buyer-held LOT-D certificates and preserved FACT035 establishes the frozen qualified-unit source boundary before the new control is evaluated.
CF023 links QX-38983-2025 to NON38983, MA RPS 1015-02, Deer Island Treatment Plant STG, and the same LOT-D unit identity used by the seller and authority records.
The case event sequence ends in RELEASED at 2025-06-09 11:36:20 EDT, after its earlier hold and before the noon cutoff, so RULE017 derives FACT043 as true.
With derived FACT043 true, FACT016 contributes 150 to FACT022 and the preserved terminal quantities and payable remain unchanged.

If RELEASED is absent, later than noon, or attached to another unit or case, RULE017 derives FACT043 as false and LOT-D remains outside the close pending review: accepted seller quantity becomes 800, post-cure deficiency 200, residual 160 after the same forty-unit cover, gross accepted payable USD 14,400, net payable USD 14,220, and seller inventory posting 800.
